text:
The purpose of this meeting was to review Companion Animal Travel Desk operations and align the team on booking, transfer, and check-in handling for animal travel cases.

Attendees: Caleb Berg, Mateo Park, and Maggie.

The discussion opened with a review of recent passenger guidance, with the team noting that clear handoffs at the desk continue to reduce stress for travelers and animals alike. Staff agreed that the booking path must stay simple and consistent, and the shared notes on intake and documentation were refreshed to support smoother service. <<FACT F097>> The team also discussed how to keep language calm and reassuring when explaining next steps to travelers who are managing pets such as Maggie, while still making sure every required detail is covered.

The transfer process was the next topic, and the group focused on when to bring in the escalation line and how to keep the cabin team informed once a case moves forward. <<FACT F106>> It was agreed that the desk will continue to log each transfer request promptly, with special attention to cases that involve changes in aircraft or seating arrangements. The team also discussed maintaining a warm tone in all traveler updates so that service remains steady even when plans change.

Attention then turned to check-in, where the group reviewed timing, document readiness, and the importance of early verification. <<FACT F092>> The staff noted that early preparation helps prevent delays and gives the cabin team enough time to plan for the animal's comfort during flight. The meeting closed with a short check on follow-up tasks, and everyone confirmed their roles for the next shift.

The meeting ended in a constructive and positive manner.
